title: Montana's LEO quarterly schema requires the total active-subscriber count each period
summary: The LEO instructions require subgrantees to report the total number of active subscribers as of each quarterly reporting period. Denominator: The exact awardee project and quarter, with active subscribers measured against the approved covered-location cohort.
